narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>One is two short of a hundred and one is two over. The answer is ten thousand.
<bookmark mark='small'/>Try a small case. Nine is one short of ten, and eleven is one over.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Nine times eleven is ninety nine, not one hundred, so the short and the over do not cancel.
